title: Principal Solutions Architect - Migrations
description:

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake Professional Services is the implementation and strategy experts for the Snowflake platform. We engage with customers at all phases of the customer journey to optimize, accelerate, and achieve business outcomes. Our teams of Solutions Architects demonstrate technical leadership everyday by writing code, constructing solution architectures, and guiding customers through decision paths to achieve impactful outcomes. We advise everyone from developers through senior executives on how best to utilize Snowflake to make their business successful. Our Solution Architects are comfortable with change and live on the cutting edge of technology.

In this role, you will lead and execute complex migrations from legacy systems to the Snowflake platform. You will collaborate closely with customers and system integrators to understand their requirements, design robust migration strategies, and ensure seamless transitions with minimal disruption. Additionally, you will work with a diverse range of teams both inside and outside the company.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design comprehensive migration plans and solutions tailored to the customer's needs and architecture, ensuring a seamless transition to Snowflake

- Partner with our customers, acting as the technical expert for all aspects of Snowflake during implementation

- Deploy Snowflake following best practices, including ensuring knowledge transfer so that customers are properly enabled and are able to extend the capabilities of Snowflake on their own

- Maintain deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

- Work with System Integrator consultants at a deep technical level to successfully position and deploy Snowflake in customer environments

- Create presentations and document learnings from the project. Develop utilities and accelerators to streamline migration and related activities

- Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- 7+ years of experience working with customers in a pre-sales or post-sales technical role, preferably as a solutions architect

- Experience migrating from one data platform to another and holistically addressing the unique challenges of migrating to a new platform

- Hands-on experience working with data warehouse systems including or similar to Snowflake, BigQuery, Teradata, Redshift, Netezza, SAP HANA, Greenplum, Exadata, etc.

- End-to-end experience migrating on prem data warehouse solutions to the cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)

- Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

- Understanding of complete data analytics stack and workflow, from ETL to data platform design to BI and analytics tools

- Extensive hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics and scripting languages like Python, Bash, Shell etc.

- University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- 3 years of technical consulting experience

- Experience with non-relational platforms and tools for large-scale data processing (e.g. Hadoop

title: Senior Enterprise Implementation Consultant
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal. 

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within. 

This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. 

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

• You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

• You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist, Offline Marketing (FTC)
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Digital Marketing Specialist, you’ll be responsible for planning and executing campaigns on multiple digital channels (Youtube, Social Media, Programmatic), across several markets. You’ll own high-scale budgets and orchestrate media plans that deliver growth, working in collaboration with other marketing channels, data science, and creative teams. 
As part of the Digital Reach team, you’ll join a team of passionate and creative marketers, who love solving business challenges with a laser focus on efficiency. 

In this role, you’ll focus on crafting and executing strategies to scale Vinted through video advertising, with ambitious and creative-forward campaigns. If you’re someone who has been working with online video campaigns, loves data, and wants to have a big impact on business growth - this job is for you. Your expertise in digital advertising, and deep curiosity for emerging media consumption patterns will be key to tackling our strategic challenges. 

Important note: this is a fixed-term position.

In this position, you’ll 

• Plan and execute video campaigns across digital platforms such as YouTube, Social Media, and DV360 to support business objectives

• Prepare budget recommendations and media plans that align with market goals

• Analyze campaign performance and provide insights based on data to help inform strategy

• Optimize campaigns by learning and applying best practices

• Stay up-to-date with media consumption trends within your market to support campaign decisions

• Work closely with the Offline team to help build cross-channel media plans that drive incremental reach

• Collaborate with the Marketing Analytics team to assist in setting up tests and improving campaign measurement

About you 

• 1+ years of experience in managing paid acquisition channels

• Familiarity with programmatic advertising platforms like Google Ads, and social media platforms such as Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

• Team player with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines

• Detail-oriented with a focus on working efficiently

• Creative and strategic thinker with a passion for learning and achieving results

• Comfortable working with data and eager to develop data analysis skills

• Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets (basic functions, pivot tables, and data analysis)

• Familiarity with tools like DV360 is helpful but not required

title: Senior Data Engineer - Worldwide, Part Time
description:
Role Summary:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to lead the development of scalable, reliable, and efficient data solutions in a cloud-first environment. This role requires a deep understanding of ETL/ELT processes, AWS data services, and pipeline orchestration to support enterprise-grade analytics and decision-making systems.
You will work closely with data, analysts, and engineers to transform raw data into actionable insights and support the infrastructure that powers data-driven products.
This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth startup on a 100% equity-based compensation model , aligning your success directly with the company's. You'll be part of the foundational team and directly participating in long-term value creation.

• Implement data quality monitoring, logging, and alerting within all pipeline processes.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define data requirements and ensure consistency, availability, and accessibility.

• Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering best practices.

• Ensure adherence to data security, privacy, and governance standards.

What We're Looking For:

• 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused engineering role.

• Strong experience building and managing ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.

• Hands-on experience with AWS Glue and Step Functions .

• Deep understanding of Amazon S3 and data lake best practices.

• Advanced proficiency in SQL , particularly with PostgreSQL , including performance tuning and complex queries.

• Solid programming skills in Python (or similar languages) for data processing.

• Experience designing scalable data architectures and workflow orchestration solutions.

• Familiarity with CI/CD tools, version control (e.g., Git), and DevOps principles.

Bonus Skills:

• Experience with other AWS data services (e.g., Athena, Lambda).

• Familiarity with workflow orchestration alternatives (e.g., AWS Step Functions).

• Exposure to modern data modeling concepts

• Knowledge of data security and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR).

What we Offer

• Equity: Participation in VendueTech Ltd ESOP Trust, with share allocation based on hours worked and achievements.

• Opportunity to work on innovative, data & AI-driven projects transforming the real estate auction market.

• Flexible remote work environment with global collaboration.

• Direct contribution to the success and growth of a mission-driven, forward-thinking company.

VendueTech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

title: AI Product Engineer - ClickStack

Join us in building the AI layer for Observability!

ClickStack is the open-source observability platform we're building at ClickHouse - logs, metrics, traces, and session replays unified so engineers can find root causes quickly. The interesting work now is in the agent layer: systems that can investigate an incident at 2 AM, propose a root cause, and hand the on-call a concise summary by the time they've logged in.

We're hiring an AI Product Engineer to build agentic capabilities on top of a petabyte-scale observability platform, with a focus on developer experience. If you've been building agents, designing skills, and wiring up MCP servers - and you've hit the limits of generic copilots for production work - we'd like to talk.

What you'll do

title: Pflegekräfte: Interview zu Sozialer Berührung und Robotik
description:
WAS WIR ERFORSCHEN

Wir führen eine bezahlte Studie über die Rolle von physischem Kontakt und sozialer Berührung im Pflegebereich durch. Unser Ziel ist es, die täglichen Pflegeroutinen zu verstehen und zu untersuchen, wie sich die Mensch-zu-Mensch-Interaktion auf die Mensch-Roboter-Interaktion übertragen lässt. Diese Forschung wird dazu beitragen, sichere, angenehme und effektive Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Robotik in Gesundheitsumgebungen zu definieren.

WIE ES FUNKTIONIERT

Sie nehmen an einem Remote-Interview teil, um uns durch Ihre typischen Pflegeroutinen zu führen. Wir werden Sie bitten zu beschreiben, welche Rolle physischer Kontakt bei Ihren täglichen Interaktionen mit Patientinnen und Patienten spielt. Sie werden außerdem konzeptionelle Szenarien mit Assistenzrobotern in Pflegeumgebungen prüfen und darauf reagieren. Schließlich geben Sie Feedback dazu, wo robotergestützte Assistenz sinnvoll ist und wo menschliche Berührung unersetzlich bleibt.

FÜR WEN DIES GEDACHT IST

Wir freuen uns über aktive Pflegefachkräfte, professionelle Betreuungskräfte und Pflegeassistenten mit praktischer Patientenerfahrung. Fachkräfte, die in Krankenhäusern, Langzeitpflegeeinrichtungen oder in der häuslichen Krankenpflege tätig sind, werden ausdrücklich ermutigt, sich zu bewerben. Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis der täglichen physischen Patientenversorgung und der Abläufe am Krankenbett ist für die Teilnahme erforderlich.

WAS SIE TUN WERDEN

- Beschreiben Sie Ihre tägliche Routine und physische Interaktionen mit Patientinnen und Patienten

- Bewerten Sie konzeptionelle Szenarien für die Mensch-Roboter-Interaktion in der Pflege

The AWS Cloud Engineer - IL6 / Backend & Database is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, securing, and maintaining cloud-based solutions within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Impact Level 6 (IL6) environments supporting mission-critical government and Department of Defense (DoD) programs.

The position combines advanced AWS cloud engineering, backend application development, and database engineering responsibilities. The engineer will develop and integrate backend services, APIs, data services, and database solutions while ensuring that infrastructure and applications meet stringent security, performance, scalability, availability, and compliance requirements.
This position is 100% remote.

Salary Range: 130k+

Key Responsibilities

• Design, deploy, configure, and maintain secure AWS infrastructure within IL6 environments.

• Develop, integrate, and maintain backend applications, microservices, APIs, and data services supporting mission-critical systems.

• Design and implement scalable, highly available database architectures within AWS.

• Develop and optimize relational databases, including schema design, indexing, queries, stored procedures, transactions, and performance tuning.

• Work with technologies such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB, and other AWS database services as appropriate.

• Design and implement data models and database schemas that support application and mission requirements.

• Develop cloud-native applications using serverless, containerized, and microservices architectures where appropriate.

• Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar technologies.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated application, infrastructure, and database deployments.

• Implement and maintain AWS security controls consistent with DoD, DISA, FedRAMP, NIST, and RMF requirements.

• Configure and manage AWS IAM, encryption, secrets management, security groups, logging, monitoring, and other security capabilities.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and administering AWS cloud environments.

• Demonstrated experience working in AWS IL6, AWS GovCloud, or comparable high-security government cloud environments.

• Experience with one or more enterprise database platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or Amazon Aurora.

• Experience with AWS database services such as RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, or similar technologies.

• Experience designing database schemas, data models, relationships, and data-access layers.

• Experience developing REST APIs, microservices, or other backend services.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and/or CloudFormation.

• Experience with CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.

• Experience implementing security controls within regulated AWS environments.

• Understanding of NIST 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, DISA STIGs, and DoD cybersecurity requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AWS GovCloud and IL6 environments.

• Experience with PostgreSQL/Aurora PostgreSQL in large-scale production environments.

• Experience with DynamoDB or other NoSQL databases.

• Experience with database replication, clustering, partitioning, and high-availability architectures.

description:
Role Summary
Ciroos is hiring a Technical Customer Success / Customer Program Manager to own the customer program from onboarding through adoption - connecting the dots across the customer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Product, and Engineering. This is a role for someone who knows how to drive: you'll know what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, what needs to be prioritized, and what comes next to keep the customer moving forward. You'll be the person making sure things don't fall through the cracks.
You need enough technical depth to be comfortable working with SRE, observability, cloud, infrastructure, integrations, and enterprise IT teams - but you are not expected to be the FDE building everything yourself. Your job is to make the entire program move.
What You'll Do
Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Orchestration

• Own the customer program end-to-end from onboarding through adoption, tracking what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, and what to prioritize next.

• Drive accountability across teams: when Engineering owes something, you drive it to closure; when Product needs to make a decision, you get it in front of them; when priorities compete, you help create clarity.

• Coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder technical deliverables to a clean finish - for example, driving an enterprise security questionnaire (such as a Splunk-integration review covering data retention, permissions, token encryption, and incident response) from a draft with open “pending engineering confirmation” items to a fully-owned, sign-off-ready response, assigning clear owners and chasing each item to closure.

• Maintain a single source of truth on program status - open items, owners, and dates - so nothing depends on memory or gets lost between Slack threads, docs, and meetings.

Customer Relationship & Value Delivery

• Build strong relationships with customers, understand what success looks like for them, and keep them engaged throughout onboarding and adoption.

• When the customer is waiting, make sure they always know exactly where things stand - proactive, clear, and specific status, not “checking on it.”

• Make sure Ciroos is delivering measurable value against what the customer actually cares about, not just what was scoped at kickoff.

Technical Fluency & Escalation Support

• Engage credibly with customer SRE, observability, cloud/infrastructure, security, and enterprise IT stakeholders - understanding enough of the technical substance (integrations, permissions, data handling, deployment mechanics) to keep a conversation moving without needing to build the solution yourself.

• Partner with FDE and Engineering on technical questions, security/compliance reviews, and integration asks that surface mid-program, translating between customer language and internal owners in both directions.

• Flag risk early - a stalled dependency, an unanswered question, an unclear owner - before it becomes a customer-visible problem.

What We're Looking For

• Experience leading complex enterprise customer programs - technical customer success, customer/program/project management, TAM, or solutions delivery - with a track record of driving multi-team initiatives to completion.

• A natural “what's next, who owns it, and when will it be done” operator: organized, persistent, and comfortable creating structure in a fast-moving startup environment without waiting to be told.

• Enough technical curiosity and depth to be comfortable in conversations spanning SRE, observability, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, integrations (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, ServiceNow), and enterprise security/compliance reviews.

• Excellent written and verbal communication - able to represent status clearly to customers and internally, and to get concise, unambiguous commitments out of Engineering and Product.

• Customer-focused and relationship-driven, with the judgment to balance advocating for the customer with realistic internal priori

title: Pricing and Monetization Manager
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

THE ROLE

Mercor produces all sorts of data of data types, for AI labs and enterprise customers. We're hiring someone to own pricing structures across our data types.

This person will build the pricing models, rate cards, and margin frameworks to ensure pricing is consistent and defensible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Acquisition pricing & cost modeling (buy side)

- Establish fair market value for the data we buy - by data type, domain, and end buyer - and set the acquisition cost ceilings that bound what we'll pay

- Track competitor bidding behavior and maintain the cost curves that tell us when to pay up to win a corpus and when to walk

- Model fully-loaded cost to serve: acquisition price, extraction, human QC, anonymization/PII, and LLM inference - not just what we pay the vendor

- Define the priceable unit for each data type - per repo, per file, per video minute, per audio hour - and the quality attributes that move price within a unit

Monetization & margin strategy (sell side)

- Design pricing and packaging frameworks for data by data type, volume, format, and customer segment

- Build rate cards and tiered pricing for recurring, repeatable data products

- Own unit economics per deal and per data product, including transfer pricing, internal chargeback, and direct vs. indirect revenue attribution across account P&Ls

- Build the pricing/forecasting toolkit Finance and leadership use to evaluate new data products before launch

- Continuously test and refine pricing using win/loss data, renewal behavior, and market feedback

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 6+ years in pricing strategy, monetization, revenue operations, or a related analytical/strategy role - ideally at a data, marketplace, or B2B SaaS company

- Strong financial/quantitative modeling skills - fluent in Excel/Sheets; SQL a strong plus

- Track record of building pricing models from scratch, not just tuning ones already in place

- Comfortable operating with real ambiguity - public benchmarks for pricing data assets are thin, so structured judgment matters as much as data

- Sharp cross-functional communicator - this person works daily with Sourcing, Sales, Finance, and Product

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience pricing a two-sided marketplace (a cost/supply side and a demand/sell side), not just a single-sided product

- Background in AI training data, or market data

BENEFITS

- Bi-annual performance bonus structure

- Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

- Up to $15k Relocation bonus

- $10K proximity bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

- $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

Our members aren't looking for another annual physical or a collection of diagnostic tests. Our patients are highly engaged members who are invested in their health and eager to partner with their physician over the long term. They value prevention over reaction, data over guesswork, and personalized care over one-size-fits-all medicine.
We're looking for a Founding Physician of Hone Black who wants more than a traditional clinical role. Working closely with our executive leadership, Medical Director, and operations team, you'll help design the care model, physician workflows, treatment protocols, diagnostic strategy, and clinical operating standards that will enable Hone Black to deliver a consistently exceptional member experience as we scale. We're looking for a physician who is deeply passionate about preventive, longevity-focused medicine and genuinely excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of healthcare. You are endlessly curious, stay at the forefront of emerging longevity science, and enjoy translating the latest research into practical clinical care that improves both patient outcomes and the evolution of our platform. You thrive on interpreting comprehensive biomarker data, developing highly personalized treatment plans, and delivering an exceptional, relationship-driven experience for every patient. Beyond clinical excellence, you're a builder-someone who enjoys creating new systems, refining processes, collaborating across clinical and operational teams, and solving complex challenges in a fast-moving environment. This is a highly hands-on founder role, not a corporate executive position. As our resident technical robotics expert, you will be the primary builder in the early days, focusing heavily on designing, sourcing, and adapting the hardware required to unlock physical AI automation. You will play a pivotal role in transforming a bold vision into a functional, scalable product while shaping the company's hardware and technical strategy from the ground up.
Working closely with our Lead Physical AI/Machine Learning Engineer, you will seamlessly integrate intelligent software with your hardware solutions to shape the final product. Your mission is to bridge complex robotics engineering and commercial viability, laying the foundation for a high-performing hardware and engineering culture as the company scales.
Your responsibilities

• Co-managing the company with the commercial co-founder and aligning technical strategy with business goals,

• Hands-on development & hardware prototyping: Architecting, assembling, wiring, and commissioning physical solutions-integrating Physical AI intelligence directly with custom and off-the-shelf robotics hardware,

• End-to-end physical integration & execution: Acting as a hybrid engineer/architect who can build, power up, debug, and program system prototypes from scratch, ensuring seamless communication between sensors, actuators, and controllers,

• Conducting real-world validation, field testing, and hands-on commissioning of robotic systems in operational client environments,

• Leveraging Physical AI models to drive process automation, optimizing operational efficiency in real-world, hardware-driven environments,

• Utilizing 3D simulation frameworks and Digital Twin technologies to accelerate offline testing, path planning, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation before physical deployment,

• Defining the tech stack, software/hardware architecture, and product scalability roadmap,

• Monitoring robotics, AI, and automation trends to maintain a competitive technological edge,

• Recruiting, leading, and mentoring a small, agile team of top-tier robotics engineering specialists (including mechanical engineers, mechatronics experts, and control systems engineers).

• Translating customer feedback and market needs into robust technical requirements,

• Creating an internal culture focused on code quality, ownership, rapid iteration, and high execution standards,

• Establishing rigorous hardware-software co-development workflows, CI/CD pipelines tailored for robotics (encompassing firmware, ROS/ROS2, and physical AI model deployment), simulation-to-real testing frameworks, and robust safety and data compliance standards.

Who we are looking for (must-have)

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) understand our customers’ greatest pain points and design end-to-end solutions to address them. FDSEs solicit constant feedback on their work from both customers and colleagues, improving our products over time with rapid iteration cycles.

FDSEs deploy ground breaking technical solutions to solve our customers’ hardest problems. Projects often start with a nebulous question like “Why are we losing customers?” or “How can we more effectively identify instances of money laundering?” FDSEs lead the way in developing a solution, from high-level system design and prototyping to application development and data integration. As an FDSE, you leverage everything around you: Palantir products, open source technologies, and anything you and your team can build to drive real impact.

You work with customers around the globe, where you gain rare insight into the world’s most important industries and institutions. We help our customers detect insider trading, improve disaster relief, fight healthcare fraud, and more. Each mission presents different challenges, from the regulatory environment to the nature of the data to the user population. You will work to accommodate all aspects of an environment to drive real technical outcomes for our customers.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place - with the best colleagues - to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

Salary
 
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000- $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.
